BOSS BATTLE\nDefeat Pisteus!!
What the hey is thaaat?!\nGetting bitten by such thing would be an instant\ndeath...Sorry, I'm too shocked to even stand up...
This monster is our enemy.\nIf you are willing to assist, we, Injes will fight\ntogether with you!
Thanks to you the children are safe.\nI'm sorry for being rude earlier...
No, I should apologize too for being harsh...
Again, why are the people from an ethnic minority\nin the desert like Inje here?
Not long ago, Grecia's energy sprang up.\nThe scattered Injes who felt it followed it and\nended up gathering here.
That was the time Grecia saved you with the light\narrow when you almost got killed by the monster,\nwasn't it?!
Grecia did?! The light arrow?!\nDid you really see Grecia?!\nYou've met her before?!
You told him that it was Grecia who saved and\nevacuated you to the Dark Realm when you were\nbadly injured.
You also told him that you withdrew with her and\nthe others...
You fought alongside Grecia...you're an amazing\nperson! None of the Injes here has ever met her.\nI want you to tell the villagers about her!!
Oh right, who's the god that the Injes worship\nagain...? Is it Grecia?
So, you're the sidekick, eh?\nWell then, do come this way. I'll be sure to\nroll out the VIP treatment for you then.
What? Sidekick?! That doesn't feel right...
